---
title: "Data: citations"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("data/catalogue/helpers.R")
downloads <- utils::read.csv("data/catalogue/downloads.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ids <- c("snap-cit-hepth", "snap-cit-hepph", "kddcup2003-hepth", "nber-patent-citations")
```

Citations from one paper or patent to earlier ones, dated by the citing document. All of a document's citations happen at its own date, there is no reciprocity, and each pair fires once, so these are one-shot processes for `risk = "remove"` with popularity (in-degree) as the main endogenous driver.

The [data catalogue](data-catalogue.html) lists every dataset with its licence. Figures
and numbers on this page are aggregates computed from the files as published;
each section links the source and the code that reads it.

```{r summary-table}
summary_table(ids)
```

```{r sections, results = "asis"}
render_group(ids)
```
